How baccarat works, in under a minute.

Two hands, Player and Banker, race to 9. Tens and face cards count 0, and only the last digit of a total counts. You make no decisions, and every bet still has a house edge: 1.06% on Banker, 1.24% on Player, 14.36% on a tie.
